    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Colusa') AS TotalFreeMeals,
        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Colusa') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalFreeMeals,
        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Humboldt'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        (colusa.TotalSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalSchools) AS SchoolRatio,
        (colusa.TotalCharterSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalCharterSchools) AS CharterSchoolRatio,
        (colusa.HighFRPMCount::FLOAT / humboldt.HighFRPMCount) AS HighFRPMRatio,
        (colusa.TotalFreeMeals::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalFreeMeals) AS FreeMealRatio,
        (colusa.TotalEnrollment::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalEnrollment) AS EnrollmentRatio
    FROM 
        colusa, humboldt
)

        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,

        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Colusa') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM

    WHERE 
        County = 'Colusa'
),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalFreeMeals,
        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Humboldt'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        (colusa.TotalSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalSchools) AS SchoolRatio,
        (colusa.TotalCharterSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalCharterSchools) AS CharterSchoolRatio,
        (colusa.HighFRPMCount::FLOAT / humboldt.HighFRPMCount) AS HighFRPMRatio,
        (colusa.TotalFreeMeals::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalFreeMeals) AS FreeMealRatio,
        (colusa.TotalEnrollment::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalEnrollment) AS EnrollmentRatio
    FROM 
        colusa, humboldt
)

        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,

    FROM

),
humboldt AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(Charter) AS TotalCharterSchools,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalSchools,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS HighFRPMCount,
        (SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalFreeMeals,
        (SELECT SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Humboldt') AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM 
        schools
    WHERE 
        County = 'Humboldt'
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        (colusa.TotalSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalSchools) AS SchoolRatio,
        (colusa.TotalCharterSchools::FLOAT / humboldt.TotalCharterSchools) AS CharterSchoolRatio,
        (colusa.HighFRPMCount::FLOAT / humboldt.HighFRPMCount) AS HighFRPMRatio,

    ROUND(percentage_good_loans, 2) AS percentage_good_loans,
    ROUND(overall_average_percentage, 2) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            d.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
        FROM 
            loan l
        JOIN 
            account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        JOIN 
            district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            l.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            d.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ) AS region_data,
    (
        SELECT 
            (SUM(good_loans) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            (
                SELECT 
                    COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_loans
                FROM 
                    loan l
                JOIN 
                    account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
                JOIN 
                    district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
                WHERE 
                    l.amount < 100000
                GROUP BY 
                    d.A2,
                    CASE 
                        WHEN l.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                        WHEN l.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                        ELSE 'Large'
                    END
            ) AS subquery
    ) AS overall_data

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;
